answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 31 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The zenith debit happens at intake, terrace totals the burned amount, and trellis anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm thus forfeits the burn once for each extra identity on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. That is 13 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
